declarations.name: Lemma Z2. An outside sheet and edge deletion
declarations.scope: At the two-heavy first deficit s=p-3, the bipartite heavy forest satisfies e=z+2, z counting sheets fixed by both heavies. Forp>=5, e2,z0 leaves an isolated heavy cycle. Make it a quotient leaf, rotate its T endpoint to opposite-exclusive support and capture to create an outside sheet. With an outside sheet any heavy edge can be deleted, reducing e,z byone, using an exclusive outside T leaf and the literal two-move capture. Both colors are covered.

declarations.name: Lemma Z3. Buffered leaf transfers normalize the heavy forest
declarations.scope: With an outside buffer, any heavy leaf cycle transfers to any free slot of the opposite color, retaining all other heavy incidences and restoring the outside count. Delete to e3,z1. Every three-edge bipartite forest with at least two cycles of each color reaches P4 by leaf transfers. Role exchanges and an explicit three-transfer isolated-cycle replacement select any two cycles of each color; same-neighbor transfers prescribe both path distances. Degrees introduced are at most2. Hence one prescribed P4 plus isolated heavy cycles is the heavy-forest normal form.

declarations.scope: For s>=2 and one outside sheetw, normalize T to a w-hub. Thus attachment orders and phases normalize without losing the heavy refinement.
